description: Use this when the buyer asks whether Pinflower delivers to a place in Prague, how much delivery costs, how soon it can arrive, or whether flowers can come tonight — before choosing a bouquet. Pass the place as the buyer said it. Not needed when you are already searching bouquets for that place.

date.description: Delivery/pickup day: 'today', 'tomorrow' or YYYY-MM-DD (Prague). Omit for as soon as possible.

locale.description: The buyer's language for names, texts and links: cs, en, ru or uk (default cs).

where.description: Where the flowers go, as the buyer said it: a Prague district ('Praha 5'), a quarter ('Vinohrady', 'Smíchov') or a street address. Omit when unknown.

name: pinflower_check_delivery
title: Check delivery to a place
